name_full: 雅娜伊娜·马尔克斯 Janaina Marques
introduction: Janaína Marques is a Brazilian director and screenwriter, trained at the EICTV (Cuba). She is currently directing and writing the animated feature Os Olhos Do Caranguejo, a Brazil–Chile–Spain co-production. She signs the award-winning short film Los Minutos, Las Horas, which premiered in the Cinéfondation at the 2010 Cannes Film Festival and received prizes in Clermont-Ferrand, Biarritz, Havana, San Sebastián and Zinebi, including the Prix Radi from the Agence du Court Métrage Française.
